items.name: Repair Aura

items.name: Mega Repair Aura

stats: nuvem healaura6 (healAura, efeito 3, raio 5, dura 10s, custo 70 vapor, recarga 13s)

items.name: Overhaul Aura

items.name: Fortress Aura

The reality of the fortress constantly 'remembered' being undamaged and thus was functionally indestructible. items.name: Aura of Caduceus

stats: nuvem healaura9 (healAura, efeito 3.6, raio 5, dura 10s, custo 70 vapor, recarga 13s)

items.name: Aura of Resurrection
items.description: I wish that no one would ever die. That there was no violent tragedy. But this is not that world. So we must instead be satisfied with rebirth.
stats: nuvem healaura10 (healAura, efeito 3.8, raio 5, dura 10s, custo 70 vapor, recarga 13s)

items.name: Aerial Mines
items.description: Dispenses floating mines that make a delicate ticking noise.

items.name: Humming Mines
items.description: Dispenses mines. 'The western continents have been sealed these long centuries by nested blockades of self replicating aerial mines. Our current versions are derived from delicately reversed engineered samples.'

items.name: Rattler Mines
items.description: Dispenses mines. 'We have fragmented tales telling of a vast, paranoid kingdom that ruled the central land bridge connecting the north and south landmasses. At some point, they undertook the closing off of their borders. First land, then sea and finally air.'

items.name: Singing Mines
items.description: Dispenses mines. The mines of the lost continents appear to communicate with one another; a form of singing that rises to a operatic crescendo as intruders grow close. Some crude intelligence flows through the defensive network.

items.name: Copper Mines
items.description: Dispenses hand-burnished copper explosives. They shine so prettily.

items.name: Double Mines
items.description: The outer shelf explodes, crushing the inner shell. Such light!

items.name: Brass Mines
items.description: Dispenses heavily armored mines. So we don't repeat the incident that left General Beakerton blind.

items.name: Geared Mines
items.description: When the gear ratio matches up exactly with the encrypted key, three critical substances are auto-injected into the core.

items.name: Fission Mines
items.description: The fallout from mines like these does little for property values.

items.name: Fusion Mines
items.description: One small lad discovered that fusion is not just a low cost energy source.

items.name: Lava Mines
items.description: Sends shockwaves downward into the crust. Lava bursts forth.

items.name: Hunter Killer
items.description: Doesn't freeze enemies for as long as normal mines do, but that's because it usually kills them first.

items.name: Training Turret
items.description: Engineers deploy steam-powered turrets that shoot piercing bullets. Stay within repair range or the turret rapidly breaks down.

items.name: Basic Turret
items.description: Spawns a stationary gun. A boxy contraption that once defended Paris against the Endless Plague of zombie lemmings.

items.name: Plague Turret
items.description: Spawns a stationary gun. Basic bio-engineering gives us substantial protection against most natural illnesses. However, it does nothing to protect us from phages left hiding in ancient technologies. These mechanical plagues cleanse whole territories with disturbing regularity.

items.name: Assault Turret
items.description: Spawns a stationary gun. The Endless Plague incubated in a population of tunneling scavenger rodents, uplifted from a highly prolific Microtinae subfamily. The initial infection vector was rumored to be a black floating cube recovered from the body cavity of a buried pregyptian colossus. Details are, of course, lost.

items.name: Eiffel Turret
items.description: Spawns a stationary gun. The earliest field reports (Culmette Files, circa 1507) note the abnormally increased reproduction. Matter, particularly mammalian flesh was suctioned up through hollow serrated hairs of an infected subject. And rapidly reconstituted into virulent babies.

items.name: Bastille Turret
items.description: The infection spread quietly through the burrows. A temperature change, the first warm day of spring, seems to have triggered the lemming horde's eruption to surface. At this point, in the recovered writings of journalist Gullston Calmette, they were 'a vast churning sea of hunger'

items.name: Blasted Turret
items.description: The initial wave engulfed much of the porcine quarter. The Red Wall, famous for the thousands of bouquets left each April at its base, commemorates their passing. The sus-ungulate line has sadly never fully recovered and we sing ballads of their lonely decline.

items.name: Ruined Turret
items.description: Avian coggers survived a key attack on their workshops due to an inherent immunity. After an internal struggle (dramatized in the popular operatic 'Ils Rampent') a core group of engineers began fortifying their position.

items.name: Haunted Pillbox
items.description: The lemmings repeatedly attacked a west-side embankment manned by a single 75-year old factory cogger, the mythic Henri Spiner. For 134 days, endless attacks were turned aside by a lone pillbox. When rescue finally arrived, they found Spiner long dead of starvation. In his final days, he'd perfected an automated turret and hooked it to an eternal hotbox-based steam generator.

items.name: Midnight Turret
items.description: Hand-copied blueprints of the Spiner-turret enabled pockets of survivors to cobble together their own automated defense systems. Slowly a network of defended bunkers and tunnels spread across the ruined city. Children of the time say their fondest memories were of the soothing thunk, thunk, thunk as guns chewed through that endless sea of screaming lemmings.

items.name: Last Turret
items.description: During the fourteen years the tunnel camps lay besieged, coggers made their turrets ever lighter and more deadly. When the city militia finally took to the air, they were able to herd the now cannibalistic plague zombies towards the sea.

items.name: The Charmer
items.description: LOVERS SET: When the Charmer saw the Beauty dancing all alone, they were struck speechless. [Charmer turrets upgrade Beauty turrets]

items.name: Pet Turret

items.name: Repair Kit
items.description: Limited use repair kit. Starts with 5 charges.

items.name: Flock founder token
items.description: By using this token you can create your own flock and be the founder.

items.name: Alpha Afterburner Trail
items.description: A rare trail that only was available for early Alpha testers. The flames burn with the passion of the first Rebels.

items.name: Autumn Breeze Trail
items.description: Gather resources and store them away. It's never enough. Darker times lurk on the horizon and survival is necessary for the Rebel Alliance.

items.name: Open Beta Trail
items.description: Show a little love for the players who were with us before we launched.

items.name: Ice Blue Blast Trail
items.description: The analog circuits in this old beast produce a chill synthetic soundscape. Feels like syncopated ice clinking in a glass of cool water. Put on your headphones. Focus. Your mind is clear.

items.name: Lemon Lime Blast Trail
items.description: Everyone needs a pick-me-up, a shock to the system, a second wind. There's a caution label on the back with lettering too small to read. You haven't slept in days.

items.name: Violet Blast Trail
items.description: During the decline of the Egyptian era, as the barbarians rose from their frozen dust crypts, the elite spent much of their time fearing the end of the world. So, they wrote oh so mournful ballads. 'Art! From agony,' they moaned. Hey now! Don't be sad! Remix those soulful classics with a bit of contemporary bass! Ohh la la! Do you feel it? Do you f-f-feel the joy?

items.name: Arena Trail
items.description: Why do the Arenas exist? Who is doing the testing? What are they testing for?

items.name: Doomsday Trail
items.description: One day, birds will return to the moon.

items.name: Venom Trail
items.description: You hear the song of the great snake mind. It knows how this all ends.

items.name: Vault Trail
items.description: When the Empire came to power, they sent their dog minions to pillage the museums. Those works that did not support the glory of Feline supremacy were burned and their creators struck from all records.

items.name: Owl Trail
items.description: The Frozen Horror only wished to save the owls. For it knew that civilization is cylical. And if there is no preservation in winter, there can be no new growth in the spring.

items.name: Deep Ones Trail
items.description: Oh, crimson waters, pooling inside us. They've been here for so long. They know us. They made us.

items.name: Phoenix Trail
items.description: Shame. It burns hot. And follows us wherever we go.

items.name: Cultist Trail
items.description: The fact that you know it to be a lie does nothing to reduce its power.

items.name: Vault Trail
items.description: When the Empire came to power, they sent their dog minions to pillage the museums. Those works that did not support the glory of Feline supremacy were burned and their creators struck from all records.

items.name: Alpha Bubbley Trail
items.description: A rare trail that only was available for early Alpha testers. Sophisticated like the champagne on a chilly autumn balcony, as we watch the Imperial City burn.

items.name: Sim Cube Trail
items.description: Only the best solo pilots can hope to earn this Combat Simulation trail reward.

items.name: Flock Sim Trail
items.description: It takes a truly great Flock Simulation team to earn this Combat Simulation trail reward.

items.name: Blue Flame Trail
items.description: Hot in here; feeling dizzy. Why does it smell like burnt mangos? Yeah, The Fence mentioned the gel was volatile, but then he smirked and said not to worry. Surely a skilled pilot like yourself knows how to stay safely out of trouble.

items.name: Purple Flame Trail
items.description: Merging the flaming coils was not advised. A flash of purple, so bright, so vibrant! Their eyes watered behind their goggles as they stood in awe of their new creation.

items.name: Red Flame Trail
items.description: We inherit the rage of past generations. Insults. Injustices. Do you feel the enormous weight of their losses? Will you repeat their mistakes? And leave your enemy's ashes in the wake of your anger?

items.name: Orange Galaxy Trail
items.description: A universal music reveals itself in the slow churning of a night sky on fire. Breath. Observe. Fly.

items.name: Yellow Galaxy Trail
items.description: Why, girl? Why you sing sad songs? Wanna fly straight up, beyond the horizon. Beyond this endless horror inside all of us.

items.name: Teal Galaxy Trail
items.description: The radio crackles. There are strange rhythms in the background radiation...a ghostly tune that speaks of worlds layered, compacted, rebuilt time and time again.

items.name: Green Energy Trail
items.description: Donning ruffled feathers and frantic expressions, the scientists demonstrated the use of their new silent energy source. Everyone was impressed. The faintest smell of lemon is left in the wake.

items.name: Blue Helix Trail
items.description: When Melody Johns sings the blues over the wireless, the fusion plasma dances right along.

items.name: Gold Helix Trail
items.description: Melody Johns released a golden record. The civilized world still celebrates.

items.name: Green Helix Trail
items.description: She gave into envy once. Ms. Johns sings she wanted another who wasn't hers. The cyclotron hums with green desire.

items.name: Purple Helix Trail
items.description: Melody Johns once warbled, 'Dead passion so damned. Aching like a fresh bruise.' Your engine sobs.

items.name: Red Helix Trail
items.description: The angry beat rages. Melody Johns was spurned. Such a lady demands her due.

items.name: Alpha Ion Trail
items.description: A rare trail that only was available for early Alpha testers. When equipped, a gush of static wafts across the radio waves.

items.name: Ectoplasmic Trail
items.description: Long after their deserved death, the horrific acts of Meowza's nobles echo across our land.

items.name: Blue Plasma Trail
items.description: Music bounced off our atmosphere's radioactive troposphere gets piped into the cockpit. The superstitious synchronize their fusion drives to the buzzing beat.

items.name: Gold Plasma Trail
items.description: Cylinders of soft gold etched with music of the spheres turn eternally in some elder cavern. A ramshackle antenna a kilometer high blasts the tunes halfway round the world.

items.name: Green Plasma Trail
items.description: Your engine roars to the syncopation of Poison House. Pilots who prefer such music are shunned in social settings.

items.name: Purple Plasma Trail
items.description: Royal marches of times now lost are favored by loyalists. The cadence gives their exhaust a ponderous purple glow.

items.name: Red Plasma Trail
items.description: Every hundred years a singer like Melody Johns comes along. Her capture by the Empire fuels our rage. So say the war posters.

items.name: River Trail
items.description: The gurgle of the river is in the background of her strange new album. It's avant-garde. Not everyone understands the appeal, but those who do play it over and over again.

items.name: Alpha Spike Trail
items.description: A rare trail that only was available for early Alpha testers. Sharp like the wit of the first Rebels.

items.name: Blue Star Trail
items.description: Young Rebels will remember growing up on the cliffs of the city. High above the wreckage of the war waging below, they wish on stars for peace and for summer. The warm wing of a childhood friend.

items.name: Gold Star Trail
items.description: The future of the next generation of pilots is filled with hope and prestige. They were first in their class. Have we prepared them enough for what is to come?

items.name: Alumni Trail
items.description: Planes with this trail were piloted by the Empire's elites and greatly feared. Now, the birds have co-opted it to be a symbol of hope.

items.name: Wake Trail
items.description: Pain is only evident when it was previously absent.

items.name: Moose Meat
items.description: A large pile of bioengineered moose meat.

items.name: Bomb Cat Bomb
items.description: Each Bomb Cat Bomb is assigned to a cat.  The cat that the Bomb Cat Bomb is assigned to is called the 'Bomb Cat Bomb Cat.'

items.name: Gas Canister
items.description: Poisonous gas, condensed and frozen. Enough to sterilize 10 square kilometers.

items.name: Dog Manure
items.description: It smells...awful. But keeps our Victory gardens producing beautiful tomatoes.

items.name: Ashes
items.description: Said to contain the souls of downed pilots.

items.name: Fisher Crab Parts
items.description: The remains of a destroyed Fisher Crab.  Must have been old...it's covered in barnacles.

items.name: Bio-Interface Prototype
items.description: Torture devices that are strapped on to the Empire's slave pilots to make sure they follow orders.

items.name: Shield Generator
items.description: This powerful shield can create a protective barrier on multiple units at once.

items.name: Energy Pack
items.description: The Empire uses blocky contraptions for energy storage. Sounds nice, but it's mostly used for burning rebellious grannies.

items.name: Escape Pod
items.description: Contains an enemy pilot. You can hear him hurling insults in another language.

items.name: Kinetic Sphere Core
items.description: Even though it's only the size of a watermelon, it can act as a giant wrecking ball when the kinetic energy field is activated.

items.name: Flamer Tank
items.description: Highly Flammable Fuel. Smells like uncooked marshmallow.

items.name: Rhino Horn
items.description: It sparkles. You feel so chaste. For the first time ever.

items.name: Nano Honey
items.description: Nano package, Mega taste. Can be used in fine black tea.

items.name: Plane Data Core
items.description: Contains flight pattern data from our downed planes. Stimulating.

items.name: Zombie Bone
items.description: It screams quietly if you tap it with a hammer.

items.name: Shark Tooth
items.description: A metal spike made to look like a vegan shark tooth. 3 feet long and pretty.

items.name: Toxic Waste
items.description: Storing the glowing crawling goop in a cardboard box seems ill considered.

items.name: Plague Bacteria
items.description: Contained in a sleek phallic glass casing marked with a smiley face.  It looks both masculine and very fragile.

items.name: Blink Data Core
items.description: The Empire's encrypted messages.  Sometimes it is secret intel.  Other times it is a recipe for cooking mice.

items.name: Beast Claw
items.description: Resonates at a calming E flat when struck.

items.name: Prison Box
items.description: A sturdy metal box used to transport prisoners. You can hear grumpy noises coming from inside.

items.name: Eye of Meowza
items.description: To the Empire, its a symbol of their leader and religion. To all others, it's a symbol for fear and oppression.

items.name: List of Names
items.description: It's a list of names; Most of them are crossed off.  It's also has a disturbing amount of blood on it.

items.name: Imperial Coin
items.description: A unique numbered coin made by feline robots. Each is minted using arcane mathematical rituals and the blood of a thousand mice.

items.name: Ancient Idol
items.description: A beaten golden statuette of a figure brandishing a gladius. The archaeologists believe it represents a bird gladiator known only as Rustling Crow.

items.name: Arena Gem
items.description: Mysterious device retrieved from the Arena. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.name: Blue Steel
items.description: Material used for crafting and upgrading 'Water' equipment.

items.name: Cube Gem
items.description: A token of your prowess in the Combat Sim. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.name: Flock Sim Gem
items.description: A token of your prowess in the Combat Sim. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.description: Material used for upgrading equipment at the Workshop.

items.name: Super Copper
items.description: Material used for upgrading equipment at the Workshop.

items.name: Hyper Copper
items.description: Material used for upgrading equipment at the Workshop.

items.name: Dark Steel
items.description: Material used for upgrading Ultra-Rare weapons at the Workshop.

items.name: Doom Gem
items.description: Radioactive fragment taken from the Doomsday Device. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.name: Flame Gem
items.description: A smouldering implant, still covered with charred gore. Taken from one who deserved better. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.name: Feather
items.description: <color=#FFFFFF>Special event item!</color> Deposit as many of these in the <color=#FBB040>Workshop</color> (under <color=#FBB040>'<Special Events>'</color>) as you can before <color=#FBB040>Nov 6th</color> to become eligible for a Flock Founder Token.

items.name: Frozen Gem
items.description: Hibernation materials taken from the Frozen Horror. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.name: Soul Gem
items.description: Locked inside the crystalline matrix are the stored memories and emotions of an Imperial disciple. During Meowza's secret allegiance ceremonies, inductees into the inner circle are asked to consume a small ruby sliver. Upon sensing contact with sentience, it bursts opens, sending fine branching shards deep into the the subject's brain. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.description: Those who performed admirably received these gems to wear on their uniform. Students who continuously failed to earn them were often publically shamed.

items.description: Elder artifact taken from the Depths. They are watching you. They are watching you. They are watching you. Used for crafting a trophy item at the Workshop.

items.description: Something flavorful or an attempt at such.

items.name: Bone
items.description: Go go bone! Um... it does nothing.

items.name: Tooth
items.description: It's not entirely clear where this tooth fell out, or if it's even a tooth, but we're calling it a tooth now.
